title: Stop Using Claude Like a Beginner (16 Productivity Hacks)
description:
Here are 16 Claude hacks that will save you hours, grow your business, and boost your productivity in ways that will blow your mind.

You can use Memory Import to migrate everything from ChatGPT to Claude in under two minutes. The Model Selector lets you use Haiku for fast data, Sonnet for drafts, and Opus for complex analysis. Stop touching your inbox with the Gmail Connector, and use the Calendar Connector to analyze if your time aligns with your quarterly goals.

You can also use Artifacts to write working mini-apps in the chat, Projects to share preloaded context with your team, Voice mode to talk three times faster than you type, Scheduled tasks to automate repeating jobs, and Claude Code to code anything in plain English.

Get the 16 Claude hacks here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1UpBDcQpgjWX6YfMcDdAUaOh88kXrOu1VYrs9tuIx62Y/edit?usp=sharing

#ClaudeAI #Productivity #BusinessTips #Founders #TechTips #Automation #TechHacks
